ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $DE$ is the perpendicular bisector of side $AC$ of $\triangle ABC$, with the foot of the perpendicular at point $E$, intersecting $AB$ at point $D$. Connect $CD$, $\angle B=30^\circ$, $CD\perp BC$, $CD=3$, then what is the length of $AB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $DE$ is the perpendicular bisector of side $AC$ of $\triangle ABC$, and $CD=3$, \\
it follows that $AD=CD=3$, \\
Because $\angle B=30^\circ$ and $CD\perp BC$, \\
it follows that $BD=2CD=6$, \\
Hence, $AB=AD+BD=\boxed{9}$.
